outputSchema.description: OpenAI chat.completion object; the reply is choices[0].message.content.

snippets.curl:
# Chat with model gpt-4o-mini through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint
# Requires curl 7.76+ and jq. Export SWFTE_API_KEY first.
BASE_URL="https://api.example.test/agents"
curl -sS --fail-with-body -X POST "$BASE_URL/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SWFTE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"content":"Hello","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-4o-mini"}' | jq -r '.["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]'
snippets.python:
# Chat with model gpt-4o-mini through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint
# pip install requests  (export SWFTE_API_KEY first)
import os

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.example.test/agents"
API_KEY = os.environ["SWFTE_API_KEY"]
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

res = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v1/chat/completions", headers=HEADERS, json={"model": "gpt-4o-mini", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}, timeout=120)
res.raise_for_status()
data = res.json()
print(data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])
